The '''Martyrs''' was a [[Star/Legends|constellation]] located in the skies above [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. It was named in honor of [[Blue Squadron (Bothan)|Blue Squadron's]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].
